Who we are

Making boss moves

“Come as yourself, leave as the best version of yourself.”

213 Beauty Studio is a place where all are welcomed — an environment where creativity flows and boss moves are made. We believe in community, in surrounding yourself with like-minded individuals, and in celebrating everyone who becomes a part of the 213 family.

Eight independent experts under one pink roof, each running her own book — so you always get the girl, the service, and the vibe you came for.

Our founder — Brianna “Bri” Flores. Born and raised in the East LA area, Bri always loved the art of makeup and had a passion to connect and build a beauty community of strong, like-minded women. After working at numerous beauty companies, she decided to become her own boss and start her journey as a lash tech — working out of a small room rented from a real estate office and building up her clientele over the next few years. Eventually she was able to take over the lease of the office space and turn it into her dream: a beauty studio where women come to feel beautiful, working alongside amazing women who provide other beauty services. She built her dream from the ground up — and 213 Beauty Studio continues to grow.
